pokedexEntries.bk: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

pokedexEntries.wh: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its tusks are incredibly destructive. They can easily slice through a thick, sturdy steel column every time.

pokedexEntries.as: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

pokedexEntries.sh: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon nests in caves and abandoned mines. It is docile, but it will become incredibly angry if its tusks are touched, so beware.

pokedexEntries.vi: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.
